string-array.name: recipe_overnight_oats_steps
string-array.item: Grate the apple and stir it into the oats, yoghurt and cinnamon in a jar.
Leave it in the fridge overnight, or for at least two hours.
Top with the blueberries before eating.

resources.string: Whole grain sandwich with egg and tomato

string-array.name: recipe_egg_sandwich_steps
string-array.item: Boil the egg for 8 minutes, then cool it in cold water.
Slice the tomato, cucumber and egg.
Put the lettuce, tomato, cucumber and egg on the bread.

string-array.name: recipe_berry_smoothie_steps
string-array.item: Blend until smooth. Add a little more oat drink if it is too thick.

resources.string: Lentil bolognese with whole grain pasta

string-array.name: recipe_lentil_bolognese_steps
string-array.item: Chop the onion and garlic and grate the carrot.
Fry them in the oil for a few minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 1 dl water and simmer for 15 minutes. Season to taste.
Cook the pasta as the packet says and serve it with the sauce.

resources.string: Baked salmon with broccoli and potatoes

string-array.name: recipe_baked_salmon_steps
string-array.item: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Boil the potatoes for about 20 minutes.
Put the salmon, broccoli and sliced carrot on a baking tray, drizzle with the oil and season.
Bake for 15 minutes and squeeze the lemon over before serving.

string-array.name: recipe_chickpea_curry_steps
string-array.item: Cook the rice as the packet says.
Chop the onion and pepper and fry them with the curry powder for a few minutes.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and serve with the rice.

string-array.name: recipe_chicken_stir_fry_steps
string-array.item: Cook the rice as the packet says.
Cut the chicken into strips and fry it in the oil in a hot pan until cooked through.
Add the vegetables, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Season with the soy sauce and serve with the rice.

resources.string: Vegetable omelette with whole grain bread

string-array.name: recipe_vegetable_omelette_steps
string-array.item: Chop the onion and pepper and fry them in the oil for a few minutes.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Whisk the eggs with a little salt and pepper, pour them over and cook on low heat until set.
Serve with the tomato and the bread.

string-array.name: recipe_tuna_wheat_salad_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 can of tuna in water, about 120 g

string-array.name: recipe_tuna_wheat_salad_steps
string-array.item: Cook the wheat as the packet says and let it cool a little.
Chop the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Mix everything with the lettuce and tuna and dress with the oil and lemon.

string-array.name: recipe_bean_soup_steps
string-array.item: Chop the onion, garlic, carrot and celery and soften them in the oil in a pot.
Add the tomatoes, stock and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend half of the soup if you like it thicker, season and serve with the bread.

string-array.name: recipe_chicken_bulgur_salad_steps
string-array.item: Cook the bulgur as the packet says and let it cool a little.
Slice the chicken and chop the tomato and cucumber.
Stir the yoghurt with the grated garlic, salt and pepper.
Mix the bulgur, vegetables and chicken and serve with the dressing.

resources.string: Apple and a handful of nuts

string-array.name: recipe_apple_and_nuts_ingredients
string-array.item: A small handful of unsalted nuts, about 20 g

string-array.name: recipe_apple_and_nuts_steps
string-array.item: Slice the apple and eat it with the nuts.

string-array.name: recipe_carrots_and_hummus_steps
string-array.item: Peel the carrots and cut them into sticks.

string-array.name: recipe_yogurt_with_berries_steps
string-array.item: Put the yoghurt in a bowl and top it with the berries and oats.

string-array.name: recipe_rye_porridge_with_lingonberries_steps
string-array.item: Simmer the rye flakes and oat drink for 5–7 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with the lingonberries and maple syrup.

string-array.name: recipe_avocado_toast_steps
string-array.item: Mash the avocado with lemon, salt and pepper.
Spread it on the bread and top with sliced tomato.

string-array.name: recipe_scrambled_eggs_with_spinach_steps
string-array.item: Let the spinach wilt in the butter.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and pour them in.
Stir gently until creamy and season to taste.

string-array.name: recipe_skyr_with_muesli_steps
string-array.item: Put the skyr in a bowl.
Top with the muesli, blueberries and pumpkin seeds.

resources.string: Rye bread with smoked salmon and cucumber

string-array.name: recipe_smoked_salmon_rye_steps
string-array.item: Put the salmon, sliced cucumber and dill on the bread.
Squeeze the lemon over before eating.

string-array.name: recipe_banana_oat_pancakes_steps
string-array.item: Mash the banana and mix it with the oats, oat drink and baking powder.
Fry small pancakes in the oil over medium heat.

string-array.name: recipe_mango_smoothie_bowl_steps
string-array.item: Blend the mango, banana, spinach and oat drink until smooth.
Pour into a bowl and top with the oats and pumpkin seeds.

string-array.name: recipe_tofu_scramble_on_rye_steps
string-array.item: Fry the pepper in the oil, then add the tofu, turmeric and oat drink and cook for 5 minutes.

resources.string: Breakfast burrito with egg and vegetables

string-array.name: recipe_breakfast_burrito_steps
string-array.item: Fill with the egg, tomato, avocado, cheese and lettuce and roll it up.

resources.string: Swedish meatballs with cauliflower mash and lingonberries

string-array.name: recipe_swedish_meatballs_steps
string-array.item: Mix the mince with breadcrumbs, milk, egg and grated onion.
Roll small meatballs and fry them in the butter.
Boil the cauliflower and potato and mash them with a little butter.
Serve the meatballs with the mash and lingonberries.

resources.string: Falafel with couscous and tomato salad

string-array.name: recipe_falafel_with_couscous_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 tsp olive oil, salt and pepper

string-array.name: recipe_falafel_with_couscous_steps
string-array.item: Mash the chickpeas with the onion, garlic, flour and cumin.
Shape into small patties and fry them in the oil.
Pour boiling water over the couscous and let it swell.
Mix the tomato, cucumber, tahini and lemon and serve with the falafel.

resources.string: Creamy salmon soup with potatoes and leek

string-array.name: recipe_salmon_soup_steps
string-array.item: Soften the leek and carrot in the butter.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the salmon and cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with dill, salt and pepper.

string-array.name: recipe_shrimp_pasta_steps
string-array.item: Cook the pasta as the packet says.
Fry the garlic and pepper in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns for 2 minutes and toss with the pasta.

resources.string: Tofu and vegetable curry with brown rice

string-array.name: recipe_tofu_vegetable_curry_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 tsp curry powder and 1 tsp oil

string-array.name: recipe_tofu_vegetable_curry_steps
string-array.item: Cook the rice as the packet says.
Fry the tofu cubes in the oil and set them aside.
Fry the onion, pepper and carrot with the curry powder, then add the coconut milk and simmer.
Return the tofu, stir in the spinach and serve with the rice.

resources.string: Swedish pea soup with rye bread

string-array.name: recipe_swedish_pea_soup_steps
string-array.item: Simmer the peas, pork, onion and carrot for 30–40 minutes.
Season with marjoram and serve with the rye bread and mustard.

resources.string: Root vegetable and lentil soup with rye bread

string-array.name: recipe_root_vegetable_lentil_soup_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 slice of rye bread, salt and pepper

string-array.name: recipe_root_vegetable_lentil_soup_steps
string-array.item: Soften the onion, garlic, carrot and parsnip in the oil.
Add the lentils, potato and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with the bread.

resources.string: Chicken tikka with rice and yoghurt

string-array.name: recipe_chicken_tikka_with_rice_steps
string-array.item: Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt and curry powder for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice as the packet says.
Fry the onion and chicken, add the tomatoes and simmer.
Stir in the spinach and serve with the rice.

resources.string: Cod with dill and new potatoes

string-array.name: recipe_cod_with_dill_steps
string-array.item: Fry the cod in the butter for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Serve with the peas, dill and lemon.

resources.string: Halloumi skewers with vegetables and flatbread

string-array.name: recipe_halloumi_skewers_steps
string-array.item: Thread the halloumi and vegetables onto skewers and brush with the oil.
Warm the flatbread and mix the yoghurt with the lemon juice. Serve alongside.

resources.string: Jacket potato with beans and cheese

string-array.name: recipe_jacket_potato_with_beans_ingredients
string-array.item: 150 g white beans in tomato sauce

string-array.name: recipe_jacket_potato_with_beans_steps
string-array.item: Bake or microwave the potato until soft.
Split the potato and fill it with the butter, beans, cheese and salad.

resources.string: Buckwheat salad with roasted vegetables and chickpeas

string-array.name: recipe_buckwheat_salad_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 handful of parsley, salt and pepper

string-array.name: recipe_buckwheat_salad_steps
string-array.item: Cook the buckwheat as the packet says.
Roast the courgette and pepper with the oil for 15 minutes.
Mix with the chickpeas, buckwheat, lemon and parsley.

resources.string: Fish cakes with potatoes and peas

string-array.name: recipe_fish_cakes_with_potatoes_steps
string-array.item: Mix the fish with the potato, breadcrumbs, egg and milk and shape into cakes.
Fry in the butter for 3 minutes on each side.
Boil the peas and serve with the lemon.

string-array.name: recipe_spinach_ricotta_lasagna_steps
string-array.item: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil and add the tomatoes. Simmer, then stir in the spinach.
Layer the sheets with tomato sauce, spinach and ricotta.
Top with cheese and bake at 200 °C for 25–30 minutes.

string-array.name: recipe_beef_and_root_vegetable_stew_steps
string-array.item: Brown the beef in the oil.
Add the chopped vegetables and the stock and simmer covered for 30 minutes.

string-array.name: recipe_minute_steak_with_tomato_salad_steps
string-array.item: Season the steak and fry it for 1–2 minutes on each side, then let it rest.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, rocket, oil and lemon and serve alongside.

resources.string: Rice noodles with prawns and vegetables

string-array.name: recipe_rice_noodles_with_prawns_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 clove of garlic and 1 tsp grated ginger

string-array.name: recipe_rice_noodles_with_prawns_steps
string-array.item: Soak the noodles as the packet says.
Stir-fry the garlic, ginger and vegetables in the oil.
Add the prawns for 2 minutes, then the noodles and soy sauce, and toss.

string-array.name: recipe_chana_masala_steps
string-array.item: Cook the rice as the packet says.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil and add the spices.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.

string-array.name: recipe_banana_with_peanut_butter_steps
string-array.item: Slice the banana and spread or dip it in the peanut butter.

string-array.name: recipe_edamame_steps
string-array.item: Drain and sprinkle with the salt.

string-array.name: recipe_roasted_chickpeas_steps
string-array.item: Dry the chickpeas and toss them with the oil and spices.

resources.string: Cottage cheese with tomato and pepper

string-array.name: recipe_cottage_cheese_with_tomato_steps
string-array.item: Dice the tomato and pepper and mix them with the cottage cheese.

string-array.name: recipe_boiled_egg_with_crispbread_steps
string-array.item: Boil the egg for 8 minutes and cool it.
Peel and slice it and put it on the crispbread with the cucumber.

string-array.name: recipe_tuna_rye_crispbread_ingredients
string-array.item: 1 can of tuna in water, about 60 g

string-array.name: recipe_tuna_rye_crispbread_steps
string-array.item: Mix the yoghurt with dill and pepper and spread it on the crispbread.
Top with the tuna and cucumber.

string-array.name: recipe_quick_bean_wrap_ingredients
string-array.item: ½ tsp cumin, salt and pepper

string-array.name: recipe_quick_bean_wrap_steps
string-array.item: Mash the beans with the lime, cumin, salt and pepper.
Warm the tortilla and spread the beans on it.
Top with avocado, tomato and lettuce and roll it up.
